extracted.intended_audience: general public, researchers, and defense/technology stakeholders interested in DARPA programs
extracted.subtask_description: Extract explicit technical goals, performance targets, and stated program objectives from a Wikipedia page listing DARPA research programs; each entry corresponds to a program-level requirement or desired capability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Forensics (MediFor) objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Automatically spot digital manipulation in images and videos, including Deepfakes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MediFor ran 2018–2020 and inspired a follow-on program SemaFor launched in 2021.

rubrics_metrics.name: Semantic Forensics (SemaFor) objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop technologies to automatically detect, attribute, and characterize falsified media (text, audio, image, video) to defend against automated disinformation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SRI International and Kitware were working on SemaFor with an expected completion date of July 2024 (per page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Millimeter-wave GaN Maturation (MGM) requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop new GaN transistor technology to attain high-speed and large voltage swing at the same time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Phase work noted (HRL Labs on phase 2 as of FY2020).

rubrics_metrics.name: Modular Optical Aperture Building Blocks (MOABB) goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Design free-space optical components in a single device and create wafer-scale systems that are 100× smaller and lighter than existing systems and steer optical beams far faster than mechanical components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research to design electronic-photonic unit cells tileable into large-scale planar apertures (up to 10 cm diameter) capable of running at 100 watts optical power; overall application goals include rapid 3D scanning using devices smaller than a cell-phone camera, high-speed laser communications without mechanical steering, foliage-penetrating perimeter sensing, remote wind sensing, and long-range 3-D mapping. Analog Photonics LLC worked on phase 3 with expected finish May 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-Azimuth Defense Fast Intercept Round Engagement System (MAD-FIRES) objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop technologies that combine missile advantages (guidance, precision, accuracy) with bullet advantages (speed, rapid-fire, large ammunition capacity) for a medium-caliber guided projectile to defend ships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Raytheon was working on phase 3 to enhance seeker performance and demonstrate engagement capabilities (expected completion Nov 2022).

rubrics_metrics.name: Near Zero Power RF and Sensor Operations (N-ZERO) goal
rubrics_metrics.description: Reduce or eliminate the standby power that unattended ground sensors consume.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program cited as 2015 initiative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Neural implants / brain–computer interface objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop novel, nonsurgical, bi-directional brain–computer interfaces with high spatio-temporal resolution and low latency for potential human use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as soldier neurotechnology research (2014+).

rubrics_metrics.name: No Manning Required Ship (NOMARS) capability
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop uncrewed surface vessels (USVs) that operate without onboard human crews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: USX-1 Defiant, a medium USV, was publicly visible in March 2025; program grouped with Sea Train and Manta Ray as naval-impacting programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open, Programmable, Secure 5G (OPS-5G) objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Address security risks of 5G by pursuing research to develop a portable standards-compliant, open-source, secure-by-design network stack for 5G mobile (and subsequent mobile networks).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seeks to create open source software and systems enabling secure mobile networks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operational Fires (OpFires) goal
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop a new mobile ground-launched booster to help hypersonic boost-glide weapons penetrate enemy air defenses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lockheed Martin worked on phase 3 propulsion components (expected completion Jan 2022); system successfully tested July 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Persistent Close Air Support (PCAS) objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Fundamentally increase Close Air Support effectiveness by enabling dismounted ground agents (JTACs) and combat aircrews to share real-time situational awareness and weapons systems data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program created in 2010 to improve coordination between ground and air assets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Robotic Servicing of Geosynchronous Satellites (RSGS) capability
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop telerobotic and autonomous robotic satellite-servicing technologies to service satellites in geosynchronous orbit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Northrop Grumman's SpaceLogistics selected as partner; U.S. Naval Research Laboratory developed the robotic arm; anticipated to start servicing satellites in space in 2025.

rubrics_metrics.name: Robotic Autonomy in Complex Environments with Resiliency (RACER) objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure algorithms are not the limiting part of autonomous systems so that autonomous combat vehicles can meet or exceed soldier driving abilities in complex off-road environments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Four-year program (2020); experiments included off-road unmanned vehicle performance testing (March 12–27, 2023).

rubrics_metrics.name: SafeGenes mandate
rubrics_metrics.description: Program to program 'undo' sequences into gene editing programs to enable reversibility/mitigation of genome edits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Synthetic biology project started in 2016 to provide 'undo' safeguards for gene editing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sea Train objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop and demonstrate ways to overcome range limitations in medium unmanned surface vessels by exploiting wave-making resistance reductions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applied Physical Sciences Corp. undertaking Phase 1 with expected completion March 2022; Sea Train, NOMARS and Manta Ray together could extend range and payloads for unmanned naval vessels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Secure Advanced Framework for Simulation & Modeling (SAFE-SiM) goal
rubrics_metrics.description: Build a rapid modeling and simulation environment to enable quick analysis in support of senior-level decision-making.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Radiance Technologies and L3Harris were working on portions with expected completions in 2021 (per page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Securing Information for Encrypted Verification and Evaluation (SIEVE) objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Use zero-knowledge proofs to enable verification of capabilities for the US military without revealing sensitive details associated with those capabilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Galois Inc. and Stealth Software Technologies were working on the program with projected completion May 2024.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advanced Plant Technologies (Sensor plants) goal
rubrics_metrics.description: Use plants to gather intelligence by controlling plant physiology to detect chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear (CBRN) threats.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported DARPA plan from 2017 to leverage plants as sensing platforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: SHIELD (Synthetic Hemo-technologIEs to Locate and Disinfect) objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop prophylaxes and prevent bloodstream infections (BSI) caused by bacterial/fungal agents for military and civilian populations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program listed with 2023 start/aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: SIGMA radiological detection network requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Deploy a network of radiological detection devices the size of smartphones paired with larger detectors along major roads and bridges to detect small amounts of radioactive materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program noted as 2016 initiative.

rubrics_metrics.name: SIGMA+ expansion objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Build on SIGMA concepts to develop new sensors and analytics to detect small traces of explosives and chemical/biological weaponry throughout a large metropolitan area.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pilot collaboration with Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department concluded a three-month study in Oct 2021 for early detection/interdiction of WMD threats.

rubrics_metrics.name: SoSITE objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop system-of-systems integration technologies combining aircraft, weapons, sensors, and mission systems to distribute air warfare capabilities across many interoperable manned and unmanned platforms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program cited as 2015 effort to distribute capabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: SSITH (System Security Integrated Through Hardware and Firmware) requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Create a secure hardware platform integrating hardware and firmware for improved security (basis for open-source, hack-proof voting system project and a 2019 prototype).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program started circa 2017 with security-focused hardware objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Squad X Core Technologies (SXCT) goal
rubrics_metrics.description: Digitize and integrate technologies that improve infantry squads' awareness, precision, and influence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program listed as 2015 initiative to enhance small-unit capabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tactical Boost Glide (TBG) objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop an air-launched hypersonic boost-glide missile capability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a 2016 program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tactically Exploited Reconnaissance Node (Tern) mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop ship-based UAS systems and technologies to enable future air vehicles providing persistent ISR and strike capabilities with greater range and endurance than existing helicopter platforms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program seeks persistent ISR/strike from ship-based UAS (2014).

rubrics_metrics.name: ULTRA-Vis (Urban Leader Tactical Response, Awareness and Visualization) objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop a heads-up display for individual soldiers to improve situational awareness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a 2014 program for soldier visualization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Heterogeneous underwater network requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop concepts and a reconfigurable architecture leveraging advances in undersea communications and autonomous ocean systems to demonstrate utility at sea.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Raytheon BBN worked on program with work expected through May 2021 (or longer if options exercised).

rubrics_metrics.name: Upward Falling Payloads concept
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop payloads stored on the ocean floor that can be activated and retrieved when needed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program noted as 2014 concept for on-demand ocean-floor payloads.

rubrics_metrics.name: Urban Reconnaissance through Supervised Autonomy (URSA) objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop urban autonomous system technology enabling U.S. infantry and ground forces to detect and identify enemies before troops encounter them, factoring in algorithms, multiple sensors, and knowledge about human behavior to distinguish hostiles from innocent civilians.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Soar Technology Inc. worked on vehicle autonomy technology with expected completion March 2022.

rubrics_metrics.name: Warrior Web objective
rubrics_metrics.description: Create a soft exosuit to alleviate musculoskeletal stress on soldiers carrying heavy loads.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program listed starting 2014 to reduce soldier load injuries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Waste Upcycling for Defense (WUD) goal
rubrics_metrics.description: Turn scrap wood, cardboard, paper, and other cellulose-derived matter into sustainable materials such as building materials for reuse.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program noted with 2023 start-date and sustainability reuse aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program-level performance/transition expectation (implicit rubric)
rubrics_metrics.description: DARPA programs often state concrete technical performance targets (size, weight, power, speed, endurance, detection sensitivity, autonomy capability) and have phase-based contractor milestones with expected completion dates and transition goals to military/operational use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Across many program descriptions on the page (e.g., MOABB, OpFires, RSGS, SIGMA+), contractors and phase timelines are cited; successful demonstration and transition to operational partners (e.g., U.S. Navy) are recurring expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Undated and Past Projects listing (documentation standard)
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain an inventory of undated programs and past/transitioned projects that capture historical program aims and outcomes (e.g., ARPANET, DARPA Grand Challenge, X-planes, MEMEX, BigDog).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page separates active, undated, and past/transitioned projects to document objectives, prototypes, and historical impacts.
